purpose: Teach: 鉄鋼/請負/車体/減量/オペレーション/戸籍/養子/打開

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、鉄鋼業から事業を始められたぞ
lines.en: Your father started the business in steel manufacturing, you know.
lines.style: Unhurried, reflective. Gaze settling on the middle distance. Each phrase lands with the weight of real memory. Quiet authority of someone recounting what he witnessed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは請負仕事を一つ一つ丁寧に進められた
lines.en: Yes. Father approached each contract with meticulous care.
lines.style: Steady, almost formal respect. Not reciting — inhabiting the memory. Slight pause between clauses, as if honoring each detail. Voice carries both admiration and filial gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、車体設計にもこだわられたぞ
lines.en: Your father was exacting about the design work too.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. The voice of someone seeing an old photograph. Pace slows on 'design'—reliving the particularity of it. Gentle trailing-off, like he's still turning it over.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員のために減量無理は強いられなかった
lines.en: Yes. Father never pushed his staff beyond what they could bear.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A touch of emotion held close—this quality mattered. Not lecturing; simply stating a kindness he witnessed. Breath steady, but the voice softens imperceptibly on 'his staff'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お店のオペレーションを自ら点検された
lines.en: Your father checked the shop operations himself, every detail.
lines.style: Slow and deliberate. Voice carries something like pride—not boastful, but grounded. He's drawing a picture with pauses. Hangs slightly on 'himself,' letting that choice speak.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の戸籍にも理解があった
lines.en: Yes. Father understood his staff as whole people—their circumstances, their families.
lines.style: Measured, almost gentle. A shift here toward intimacy—he's moving deeper into what his father actually was. Voice doesn't quicken, but becomes more sure. Warmth without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、養子縁組のご縁を結ばれた話、聞いたぞ
lines.en: Your father helped bind together families through adoption, I heard.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. The voice softens further—this is the deepest recognition. Unhurried, almost wondering how to hold such a thing in words. Small breath before 'adoption,' like pausing before something sacred.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは苦境を打開する策を多く持っておられた
lines.en: Yes. Father held many answers for breaking through impossible situations.
lines.style: Closing statement. Voice becomes almost meditative—this is the summation. Slow, assured, each word placed with finality. Not grandiose; simply true. Breath of stillness at the end, honoring what was said.
